items.risk: Defense/intelligence demand can be program- and budget-sensitive; quarter-to-quarter satellite-services timing can be uneven.
Planet still reported a GAAP net loss and used an ATM program during the quarter, so dilution and GAAP profitability remain execution considerations.
Alternative satellite constellations, government-owned systems and other geospatial data sources can substitute for portions of Planet's offering.
Q2 net loss was $9.4M and accumulated deficit was about $1.60B; positive adjusted metrics do not yet equal sustained GAAP profitability.
Revenue growth included point-in-time satellite hardware delivery, so headline growth should not be treated as entirely recurring software-like expansion.
Growing constellation investment keeps capital intensity and execution risk material.
